import os, shutil, subprocess, sys
root = os.path.realpath(os.getcwd())
def tool(name):
    path = shutil.which(name)
    if not path:
        sys.exit('product-install: ' + name + ' must be on PATH')
    real = os.path.realpath(path)
    if os.path.normcase(real).startswith(os.path.normcase(root) + os.sep):
        sys.exit('product-install: refusing ' + name + ' resolved inside the repository')
    return real
node, npm = tool('node'), tool('npm')
subprocess.run([node, '--version'], check=True)
subprocess.run([npm, '--version'], check=True)
# Dependency install scripts must be gated by package.json allowScripts.
probe = subprocess.run([npm, 'install-scripts', '--help'], capture_output=True)
if probe.returncode != 0:
    sys.exit('product-install: this npm does not support allowScripts; npm 11 with install-script approvals is required')
sys.exit(subprocess.call([npm, 'ci', '--no-audit', '--no-fund']))
